card.name: Just before DPP-4 inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right before a DPP-4 inhibitor or metformin combination drug name (alogliptin, linagliptin, DPP-4 inhibitors), mostly after 'while', 'patients', or 'switched'.

modes.label: Verb before drug name
modes.description: A verb or preposition such as using, receiving, taking or to, directly before a gliptin or combination product name.
modes.example: It is unknown whether patients with a history of pancreatitis are at increased risk for pancreatitis while<< using>> alogliptin and metform

modes.label: Space before a number or reference
modes.description: A blank space before a number in a kidney-function threshold or section reference.
modes.example: (eGFR) greater than or equal to<< >>45 mL/min/1.7

card.writes: It seems to hold back odd name-like continuations, so the next word is a specific gliptin or metformin drug name.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a diabetes drug name like alogliptin or linagliptin.
